description.en: Your private address book: people and organisations, their accounts on the networks (Twitch, YouTube, Bluesky…), categories, notes and photo. Each person lives here once; the rest of the site only links to them.
description.fr: Votre carnet d'adresses privé : personnes et organisations, leurs comptes sur les réseaux (Twitch, YouTube, Bluesky…), catégories, notes et photo. Chaque personne n'y existe qu'une fois ; le reste du site ne fait que s'y référer.

label.en: Contacts: look up, search, add an account to a card, take a card out of a category
label.fr: Contacts : retrouver, chercher, ajouter un compte à une fiche, sortir une fiche d'une catégorie

help.fr: Sans ce droit, la personne voit les fiches, les comptes et les notes, mais jamais une adresse e-mail ni un numéro de téléphone.
help.en: Without it, the person sees cards, accounts and notes, but never an e-mail address or a phone number.

help.fr: Télécharger toutes les fiches dans un fichier (tableur).
help.en: Download every card as a file (spreadsheet).

help.fr: Par exemple « Cible de raid » depuis un autre module.
help.en: For example « Raid target » from another module.

mcp.name: contacts_list
mcp.description: List or search THE address book (people and organisations; every person of the site lives here once). Never returns e-mails or phone numbers. Use it before creating a contact (never duplicate someone). Paginated: at most 100 per call, pass 'next' as 'cursor' to continue. Filters: q (name, @handle, organisation; accents and case ignored), status ('to_review' = website form messages to check), kind, categoryId (see contact_categories), network. Partnership files only link to these people (partner_get, Partnerships module).

q.description: Text to look for: name, account handle (with or without @), organisation.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor: pass the 'next' value of the previous page to get the following one.

mcp.name: contact_get
mcp.description: Read one card of the address book: name, organisation, function, categories, accounts on the networks, notes (50 latest). No e-mail or phone (contact_get_private gives them, if your access allows it).

mcp.name: contact_get_private
mcp.description: Same as contact_get, WITH the e-mail address and phone number. Not granted by default: personal data.

mcp.name: contact_categories
mcp.description: List the categories of the address book (id, label). Paginated: at most 100 per call, pass 'next' as 'cursor'.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor: pass the 'next' value of the previous page to get the following one.

mcp.name: contact_create
mcp.description: Create a NEW card (person, or organisation with kind 'org'). Always search with contacts_list first: if the same e-mail (or the same name and organisation) already exists, that card is returned (created: false) and nothing changes. 'organisation' is the organisation's name: its card is found or created. To attach a person to a brand, then call partner_link_contact (Partnerships module).

mcp.name: contact_update
mcp.description: Change fields of a card (only the given fields change; empty text clears a field); set status to 'active' once a form message is checked. For the brand a person works with, use partner_link_contact (Partnerships module).

mcp.name: contact_note
mcp.description: Add a dated note to a card (exchange, preference, what you learned). Notes about a brand's negotiation go to the partnership journal instead (partner_log, Partnerships module).

mcp.name: contact_add_account
mcp.description: Add an account on a network to a card: a profile link or a handle (twitch.tv/name, @name…). One account belongs to one card only.

mcp.name: contact_delete
mcp.description: Permanently delete a card and its notes (spam, true duplicates). The other modules that link to it are told to forget it first. Irreversible. Disabled unless an administrator grants it to the token.
